lines: Claude just forgot what you told it.
Every message becomes a block in this box.
The box holds two lakh tokens. Then it's full.
New messages push the oldest ones out.
Ask about it now — Claude genuinely can't see it.
The fix: before it fills, ask for notes. Paste them into a fresh chat.
Ask again — instant answer. The exact prompt is in the description.
desc_prompt:
📋 THE EXACT PROMPT (copy it — works in Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini):

Before this chat gets long: summarize everything worth keeping so far — decisions, facts, numbers, names — as short notes I can paste into a fresh chat and continue exactly where we left off.
desc_cta: What's the one thing Claude keeps forgetting on you? Tell me below.
